Subject. ARREST OF ALLEGED COUNTERFEITERS OF JAPANESE MILITARY NOTES -
ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY AUTHORITIES.

Made by/ ____ and ____ Forwarded by ____ S.D.I. GRUBB.

On Dec. 31, 1938, two male and one female
Chinese were arrested on behalf of the Japanese
Gendarmerie by whom it was alleged that they
were concerned in the counterfeiting of Japanese
Military notes. After being handed over tempora-
rily to the Gendarmerie on Jan. 9, 1939, for en-
quiry they were returned to the S.M.Police on
Jan. 13. Upon return two of them, one male and
one female, were released at the request of the
Japanese, but the other, Loh Chia Ling (洛家麟),
is still in Police custody.

Since being returned no further communication
has been received from the Gendarmerie regarding
this man and so far as the Municipal Police are
concerned there is no criminal evidence against
him, and it is recommended that he be released.
According to D.S.I. Umemoto, Ser.t-Major
Shida, on behalf of Capt. Fujino, has stated
that they do not now want this man.

（印：MUNICIPAL SPECIAL BRANCH）

C 13/2
Rut 14/2
D. C. (Special Branch).

Grubb
C. D. I.

日期 1939 年 2 月 15 日。

事由：协助日本军方当局逮捕涉嫌伪造日本军用票据者。

由/ ____ 和 ____ 呈报，由 ____ 高级侦探督察格拉布（S.D.I. GRUBB）转呈。

1938 年 12 月 31 日，两名中国男子和一名中国女子因涉嫌参与伪造日本军用票据，应日本宪兵队要求被捕。1939 年 1 月 9 日，三人被暂时移交给宪兵队进行审讯，随后于 1 月 13 日交还工部局警务处。交还后，其中两人（一男一女）应日方要求获释，但另一人洛家麟（Loh Chia Ling，洛家麟）仍由警方羁押。

自交还以来，未收到宪兵队关于此人的进一步通讯，就工部局警务处而言，没有针对他的刑事证据，因此建议将其释放。据副督察长梅本（Umemoto）称，志田（Shida）军曹长代表藤野（Fujino）大尉表示，他们现在不需要此人。

（印：工部局特务科）

C 13/2
Rut 2 月 14 日
助理处长（特务科）。

格拉布
首席侦探督察

S.L.

Subject FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE.

Made by D.S.I. KONOVALOFF Forwarded by C. D. I. （印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 8277 Date ……）

Sir,

At 10 a.m. on the 12th of January 1939 Sergt. Major Shida of the Japanese Gendarmerie, handed the three arrested persons back to the custody of the S.M.Police.

Although no evidence has been produced by the Japanese Gendarmerie to warrant further detention of the 3rd arrested, Poh Chia Ling, Sergt. Major Shida requested that he (Loh Chi Ling) be detained pending production of evidence against him; whilst the 1st arrested, Chu Siau Mei and the 2nd arrested, Chu Sung Sz, could be set free.

In accordance with the instructions of D.C. " CRIME " the 1st and 2nd arrested persons were released at 5 p.m. 12.1.39, whilst the 3rd arrested man, Loh Chia Ling, is being detained at the Central Station cells.

（批：IKJ）

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

A. Konovaloff
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

报告

（印：总部 卷宗号 …… 杂项号 …… 分局，…… 日期 1939 年 1 月 13 日。）

事由：关于进一步协助日本宪兵队事宜。

由副督察长科诺瓦洛夫（KONOVALOFF）呈报，由首席侦探督察转呈（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处登记处 编号 S. B. D. 8277 日期 ……）

先生：

1939 年 1 月 12 日上午 10 时，日本宪兵队志田（Shida）军曹长将三名被捕人员交还工部局警务处羁押。

虽然日本宪兵队未提出足以证明继续拘留第三名被捕者博家麟（Poh Chia Ling）的证据，但志田军曹长要求将其（洛家麟 Loh Chi Ling）拘留，以待提出对其不利的证据；而第一名被捕者朱筱梅（Chu Siau Mei）和第二名被捕者朱松氏（Chu Sung Sz）则可释放。

根据“犯罪科”助理处长的指示，第一和第二名被捕者于 1939 年 1 月 12 日下午 5 时获释，而第三名被捕者陆家麟（Loh Chia Ling）正被拘押在中央捕房监牢内。

（批：IKJ）

此致，
敬礼，

A. 科诺瓦洛夫
副督察长

助理处长（特务科）。

Made by D.S.I. KONOVALOFF Forwarded by

Sir,

Since forwarding the previous report, none of
the members of the Japanese Gendarmerie came to C.l. to continue
interrogation of the arrested three Chinese persons, and no
further information has been received regarding the result of
enquiries conducted by the Japanese Military Police at Sungkiang.

However, D.S.I. Umemoto informed D.I. Glover that
the Japanese Military Police made a request to the effect that
the three arrested persons be handed over to them for the
purpose of interrogation.

In accordance with the instructions received
from D.C.(CRIME) by D.I. Glover, the arrested two male and one
female Chinese could be handed over for the period of 3 days
(72 hours) on the morning of January 7, 1939, but the Japanese
Military Police failed to claim the prisoners. D.S.I. Umemoto
informed the undersigned that the date for handing over of the
prisoners was set on the 8th.January, 1939, at 10 a.m.

However, the Japanese Military Police have also
failed to take the custody of the prisoners on the latter date,
and instead, J.D.C. Matsushima of the S.P.O. reported to the
undersigned that the Japanese Military Police would take over
the prisoners on the next day, i.e. 9.1.39 a.m.

At 10:45 a.m. 9.1.39 Corp.Hashimoto of the Japanese
Military Police came to C.B.H.Q. C.l. and took the custody of
the arrested persons, namely :

1st. arrested person : CHU SIAU MEI 朱筱梅
2nd. arrested person : CHU SUNG SZ 朱松氏
3rd. arrested person : LOH CHIA LING 陸家麟

P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.) against a receipt herewith attached.

先生：

自呈报上一份报告以来，日本宪兵队成员无人来到刑事侦缉处继续审讯三名被捕的中国籍人士，也未收到关于日本宪兵队在松江进行的调查结果的任何进一步信息。

然而，副督察长梅本（Umemoto）通知侦探督察格洛弗（Glover），日本宪兵队提出请求，要求将三名被捕人员移交给他们进行审讯。

根据助理处长（犯罪科）向侦探督察格洛弗发出的指示，这两名中国男子和一名中国女子本可在 1939 年 1 月 7 日上午移交，为期 3 天（72 小时），但日本宪兵队未能前来提走囚犯。副督察长梅本通知本人，移交囚犯的日期定为 1939 年 1 月 8 日上午 10 时。

然而，日本宪兵队在后一日期也未能接管囚犯，相反，特警办公室的日本侦探警佐松岛（Matsushima）向本人报告称，日本宪兵队将于次日，即 1939 年 1 月 9 日上午接管囚犯。

1939 年 1 月 9 日上午 10 时 45 分，日本宪兵队桥本（Hashimoto）伍长来到总部犯罪科刑事侦缉处，接管了被捕人员，即：

第一名被捕者：朱筱梅（CHU SIAU MEI）
第二名被捕者：朱松氏（CHU SUNG SZ）
第三名被捕者：陆家麟（LOH CHIA LING）

Accordingly, the arrested two male and one female
Chinese were conveyed to C.I Office and as the result of
questioning, the following facts were learned : -

The first arrested person, Chu Siau Mei, stated that
formerly he was employed as a secretary at the Tax Bureau of the
City Government of Sungkiang under the auspices of the Reformed
Government of Nanking.

The third arrested, Loh Chia Ling, was also employed
at the Tax Bureau of the Sungkiang City Government, working under
the first arrested man, as a clerk at the Finance Department.

On the 1st. of August, 1938, after dispensing with his
services with the Tax Bureau of the Sungkiang City Government,
the first arrested man proceeded to Soochow with a view to
securing a position as the head of the Tax Bureau of the City
Government of Soochow. However, he did not **〔此处转录不清〕** the
conditions of the intended position and left Soochow for Shanghai
where he arrived on the 13th. of December, 1938.

He emphatically denied having brought to Shanghai any
counterfeit or genuine military notes.

According to the 3rd. arrested man, Loh Chia Ling, he
arrived at Shanghai on the 1st. of November, 1938, to spend his
two weeks' sick leave, but he decided to stay in Shanghai and to
dispense with his services with the Tax Bureau of the City Gov't.
of Sungkiang. Likewise, he denied having in his possession any

因此，这两名中国男子和一名中国女子被送往刑事侦缉处办公室，经讯问后，获悉以下事实：

第一名被捕者朱筱梅称，他此前曾在维新政府治下的松江市政府税务局担任秘书。

第三名被捕者罗家麟（Loh Chia Ling）也在松江市政府税务局工作，在第一名被捕者手下担任财务部职员。

1938 年 8 月 1 日，在结束与松江市政府税务局的雇佣关系后，第一名被捕者前往苏州，意图谋求苏州市政府税务局局长一职。然而，他并未 **〔此处转录不清〕** 预期职位的条件，遂离开苏州前往上海，并于 1938 年 12 月 13 日抵达上海。

他坚决否认携带任何伪造或真实的军用票据进入上海。

据第三名被捕者罗家麟称，他于 1938 年 11 月 1 日抵达上海休两周病假，但他决定留在上海，并终止与松江市政府税务局的雇佣关系。同样，他也否认在抵达上海时持有任何

REPORT

Subject. DETENTION OF FIVE CHINESE RICE MERCHANTS FROM KIANGYIN - RECOMMENDATION TO RELEASE THEM.

Made by. A. n d. Forwarded by. C. I. D. GROUP.

Since the arrest on Dec. 29, 1938, of the five Chinese rice merchants from Kiangyin, on behalf of the Japanese Gendarmerie, by whom it was alleged that they had come to Shanghai to purchase arms for guerillas, no evidence whatsoever has been produced against them by the Gendarmerie. On the other hand local enquiries made by the police substantiate their statements that they are genuine rice dealers, therefore, in view of the length of time they have been detained and lack of evidence it is recommended that they be released.

According to D. I. I. Umoto of the J.P.O. Sergt.-Major Shida, on behalf of Capt. Fujino, has stated that they did not now want these men.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

C. D. I.

呈报人。A. n d. 转呈人。刑事侦缉组。

自1938年12月29日应日本宪兵队要求逮捕这五名来自江阴的中国米商以来，宪兵队曾指控他们来上海为游击队购买武器，但迄今宪兵队未提供任何针对他们的证据。另一方面，警方进行的本地调查证实了他们关于自己是正当米商的陈述，因此，鉴于他们被拘留时间已久且缺乏证据，建议将他们释放。

据日本警察署（J.P.O.）的 D. I. I. Umoto 称，代表藤野（Fujino）上尉的志田（Shida）警曹长表示，他们现在不再需要这些人。
